duration.text: The Clinical Science of Stomatology at Zhengzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5416 USD/per year ￥ 39000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5. Certificate of English proficiency test6.0 or above for IELTS; 80 or above for TOEFL;or other certificates which can prove that the applicant is a native English speaker or English is his/her working language at college.6. certification of no criminal record

requirements.text: 1. Candidate should be a Non-Chinese citizen, under 40 years old, the Bachelor degree holder, healthy, with non-criminal record. 2. English language requirements: for candidates from non-English spoken countries applying for EMI (English Mediated Instruction) programs, their minimum IELTS score should reach 6.5 or TOEFL score reach 90 (IBT), or equivalent. 3. Specific requirements for individual academic Schools may vary by board and subjects taken. You are advised to check with your prospective school or supervisor.
